case: Five nested PostgreSQL domains over a custom enum
contract: Catalog metadata resolves the five-domain column to the schema-qualified enum leaf.
A schema-aware keyed edit and server-inferred text query/update parameters preserve the five-layer outer domain type.
A typed equality filter selects the two updated rows and leaves an adjacent SQL NULL row intact.
An invalid enum label is rejected with SQLSTATE 22P02; independent stored-value/type queries confirm no partial write and retain the outer domain type.
The exact native row values, outer pg_typeof values, and NULL sibling are asserted after the writes.

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract::value_contract_five_domain_levels_over_enum_preserve_metadata_and_values -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

domain_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Domain chains deeper than five layers and other enum/session configurations remain untested.
This case does not close the broader B3 engine/type/consumer/configuration matrix.
